_about: Summary of each reporter's latest earnings press release (8-K exhibit 99.1 on SEC EDGAR), read 2026-11-04. Figures are copied from the release; 'headline' and 'outlook' are short paraphrases. Consensus estimates are not in the allowed sources, so beat/miss vs analysts is not assessed unless the company itself says so. Empty figs = headline numbers were not extracted from the release text.

AAPL.headline: September-quarter records for revenue, iPhone and EPS; Services at an all-time high.

MSFT.headline: Microsoft Cloud revenue $63.9B with growth accelerating to 30%; CFO says results exceeded expectations.

GOOGL.headline: Revenue +25%; Google Cloud revenue more than doubled (+103%) on AI infrastructure and TPU demand.

AMZN.headline: Record 13.9% operating margin; AWS sales +39%, its fastest growth in nearly five years. Net income fell on a prior-year Anthropic gain.

SPCX.headline: Revenue up 161% on its Super Intelligence segment and Starlink; first revenue-generating Starship mission.

META.headline: Revenue +26%, but costs +68% including a $9.89B charge for the state attorneys-general settlement; operating margin fell to 20% from 40%.

TSLA.headline: Thin profitability ($0.7B GAAP operating income); battery supply still limits vehicle volumes; Robotaxi rides with Cybercab started in Austin.
TSLA.outlook: Largest passenger-vehicle backlog in four years; record energy-storage orders.

LLY.headline: Revenue +39% on Mounjaro and Zepbound; EPS growth held back by $4.57/share of acquired IPR&D charges.
LLY.outlook: Raised 2026 revenue guidance midpoint by $5.5B to $91.0-92.0B; EPS guidance $35.00-36.00 after the IPR&D charges.

JPM.headline: Net income $15.3B; every business line grew, with CIB revenue +14% on Markets and IB fees.

V.headline: Net revenue +13%; record fiscal-year revenue of $46B; dividend raised 16%.

AMD.headline: Record quarter above the top of guidance; Data Center revenue +97% on Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs.
AMD.outlook: Expects growth to accelerate further in Q4 as Helios and 'Venice' production scales.

XOM.headline: Earnings of $15.4B; refining and chemicals improved on higher margins and record reliability.

JNJ.headline: Sales +5.9%; reported EPS only $0.09 due to a one-time talc litigation charge and deal costs.

MA.headline: Net revenue +14% as reported and currency-neutral.

ABBV.headline: Revenue +10.3% led by immunology (Skyrizi, Rinvoq) +16.3% and neuroscience +19.4%.

CVX.headline: Earnings $9.9B; U.S. upstream above 2 million boe/day for a fifth quarter and record refinery throughput.

PLTR.headline: Revenue +96%; U.S. commercial revenue +148% and now larger than U.S. government revenue for the first time. The company says guidance beat consensus.
PLTR.outlook: Raised FY2026 revenue growth guidance to 91% y/y; U.S. commercial to 143%.

KO.headline: Revenue +7% with organic growth of 7%; margins expanded; full-year guidance raised.

PG.headline: Sales +4% (organic +4%), but EPS only +1% as operating costs rose.
PG.outlook: On track for full-year guidance ranges; updated sales guidance for the Thorne acquisition.

UNH.headline: Revenue $112.7B; raised the full-year earnings outlook.
UNH.outlook: 2026 EPS of at least $19.50; adjusted at least $20.50.

MRK.headline: Sales growth came from oncology and animal health, plus newer products such as Winrevair; EPS includes a $0.12 one-time license charge.
MRK.outlook: Outlook updated to include the $0.12 license charge.

BAC.headline: Consumer Banking revenue +4% with 31 straight quarters of net checking-account growth.

GE.headline: Orders +49%; adjusted revenue +18% and adjusted EPS +36%; guidance raised across the board.
GE.outlook: Raised 2026 guidance; expects 2027 commercial services to grow low double digits.

PM.headline: Smoke-free shipments +2.7%; reported EPS fell 4.9% while adjusted EPS grew 5.4%.
PM.outlook: Full-year adjusted EPS forecast updated for currency only.

INTC.headline: Revenue +21% and above guidance, but the Q4 forecast is weak and the company expects the PC slowdown to last through at least 1H 2027.
INTC.outlook: Q4 revenue $15.0-16.0B; Q4 EPS $0.10 GAAP / $0.25 non-GAAP.

MS.headline: Net revenues $20.3B (vs $18.2B), led by equities; ROTCE 22.6%.

LRCX.headline: Revenue $8.22B (vs $6.72B a year ago) with operating margin up to 40%.

CAT.headline: Sales +17% on volume and pricing; operating margin up to 20.4%; record backlog.

TXN.headline: Revenue +28% y/y with broad growth in industrial, automotive and data center.

GS.headline: Net revenues +23%, driven by Global Banking & Markets.

NFLX.headline: Revenue +12%, in line with its own forecast; operating margin 34.6% on expense timing.

WFC.headline: EPS +13%; loans and deposits each +11%; ROTCE 16.3%.

AMGN.headline: Revenue +8% on volume; 17 products with double-digit growth.

GEV.headline: Revenue +27% led by Power and Electrification; backlog expected above $200B in Q4; buyback doubled to $20B.

IBM.headline: Revenue growth accelerated, led by Software and Infrastructure; company says it exceeded expectations.
IBM.outlook: Constant-currency revenue growth 4-5% for the year; free cash flow up more than $1B.

NVDA.headline: Revenue more than doubled (+106%) on Data Center demand.

AVGO.headline: Revenue +86%, with strong free cash flow at 46% of revenue.

BRK.B.headline: Results published Saturday 8 Aug 2026. Berkshire stresses that quarterly investment gains are usually meaningless.

WMT.headline: eCommerce +23% and membership income +17%; tariff refunds partly reinvested in lower prices; FY27 outlook raised.

MU.headline: Record revenue on AI-driven memory demand, almost 5x a year earlier.

COST.headline: Net sales +11.2%; EPS includes a $0.15 one-time benefit from tariff refunds.

CSCO.headline: Record results above the high end of guidance; about $4B of AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers in FY26.
CSCO.outlook: Expects ~$7.5B of AI infrastructure revenue in FY2027.

HD.headline: Sales +5.7% but comparable sales only +1.7%; company says results beat its own expectations.

AMAT.headline: Record revenue +25% and record non-GAAP EPS +41%.

PANW.headline: Revenue +34%; a GAAP net loss but non-GAAP profit; company says it beat its own guidance.
PANW.outlook: Targets 40% adjusted free cash flow margin in FY28.

DELL.headline: Record revenue +58% and EPS roughly tripled; full-year guidance points to 69% revenue growth.

CRWD.headline: Record net new ARR of $333M, up 51%; full-year ARR growth guidance raised.
CRWD.outlook: FY27 net new ARR growth guidance raised to 34% at the midpoint.
